summary: The XRD data across all figures demonstrate that CsPbBr3 and CsPbI3 quantum dot (QD) films synthesized via the substrate method exhibit highly consistent and phase-pure crystalline structures, as evidenced by invariant peak positions across a wide range of photoluminescence (PL) wavelengths. The powder and film XRD patterns for CsPbBr3 match simulated cubic perovskite references, while an intermediate phase powder displays a distinct set of peaks, suggesting a precursor or byproduct phase. No evidence of secondary perovskite or impurity phases is observed in the QD films, and the XRD peak positions do not shift with changes in QD size or ligand concentration.
experimental_variables: Quantum dot size (as inferred from PL peak position)

key_findings.finding: CsPbBr3 QD powders show XRD peaks at 15.1, 21.5, 30.6, 34.3, and 37.7 degrees, matching simulated cubic CsPbBr3.
CsPbBr3 QD films with PL peaks from 463 nm to 518 nm all show identical XRD peak positions at 15.2, 21.6, and 30.6 degrees.
CsPbI3 QD films with PL peaks from 641 nm to 715 nm all show identical XRD peak positions at 14.1, 20.1, and 28.3 degrees.
Intermediate phase powder exhibits a distinct set of XRD peaks at 7.6, 10.7, 15.2, 21.0, 25.2, 28.2, 32.2, and 36.8 degrees, not matching the QD film patterns.
XRD peak positions for both CsPbBr3 and CsPbI3 QD films remain constant despite changes in PL peak (i.e., QD size or ligand concentration).

scientific_interpretation.claim: The CsPbBr3 QD films are phase-pure and maintain a consistent cubic perovskite structure across a wide range of QD sizes and ligand concentrations.
scientific_interpretation.reasoning: All CsPbBr3 QD films, regardless of PL peak (463–518 nm), show identical XRD peak positions, indicating no detectable phase change or lattice distortion with size or ligand variation.

citations.evidence: All CsPbBr3 QD film curves have peaks at 15.2, 21.6, 30.6 degrees.

scientific_interpretation.claim: CsPbI3 QD films also maintain a single crystalline phase across a broad emission range, with no evidence of phase transition or impurity phases.
scientific_interpretation.reasoning: All CsPbI3 QD film samples, despite PL peak shifts from 641 to 715 nm, have identical XRD peak positions, suggesting structural stability.

citations.evidence: All CsPbI3 QD film curves have peaks at 14.1, 20.1, 28.3 degrees.

scientific_interpretation.claim: The intermediate phase powder is structurally distinct from the final QD films, likely representing a precursor or byproduct phase.
scientific_interpretation.reasoning: The intermediate phase powder shows a unique set of XRD peaks not observed in the QD films, indicating a different phase.

citations.evidence: QD film peaks do not match intermediate phase powder peaks.

scientific_interpretation.claim: The lack of XRD peak shifts with varying QD size or ligand concentration suggests that quantum confinement and surface chemistry do not significantly alter the average lattice parameters detectable by XRD.
scientific_interpretation.reasoning: Despite systematic changes in PL (and thus QD size), XRD peak positions remain unchanged, indicating lattice constants are not measurably affected.

citations.evidence: "Peak positions remain constant as PL peak shifts for both CsPbBr3 and CsPbI3 QD films"

scientific_interpretation.claim: The powder XRD pattern for CsPbBr3 matches the simulated cubic phase, confirming the assignment of the QD film peaks to cubic CsPbBr3.
scientific_interpretation.reasoning: The caption and analysis state that powder XRD peaks match simulated cubic CsPbBr3.

citations.evidence: GIWAXS and X-ray diffraction (XRD) measurements (Fig. 1e and Extended Data Fig. 1b ) show diffraction peaks indexed to the cubic CsPbBr3.
Powder XRD peaks match simulated cubic CsPbBr3

limitations.claim: No quantitative phase fraction analysis is provided for any sample, so minor impurity phases below the detection limit cannot be ruled out.

citations.evidence: phases = [] (no phase fraction or impurity analysis)

limitations.claim: No full width at half maximum (FWHM) or peak profile data is reported, limiting the ability to assess crystallite size, strain, or degree of disorder.
No lattice parameter refinement or quantitative comparison is provided, so subtle changes in lattice constants with QD size or composition cannot be confirmed or excluded.
The phase assignment for CsPbI3 QD films is not explicitly stated in the analysis, so the exact polymorph (e.g., cubic vs orthorhombic) cannot be confirmed from the provided data.
The intermediate phase powder is not explicitly identified in the analysis, and its relationship to the QD synthesis process is not fully established.
